October 25, 2018
Associated Press Texas Daybook for Thursday, Oct. 25.
The daybook is for planning purposes only and is not intended for publication or broadcast. You should verify any event you plan to cover.
Please keep the AP in mind when news develops.
To see your Daybooks and events for Texas and other States up to 12 months ahead, speak to your bureau or sales rep about access to AP Planner, or visit http://applanner.com.

Thursday, Oct. 25 – Saturday, Oct. 27 11th National Black Book Festival – 11th annual National Black Book Festival, celebrating African-American literature. Featured authors this year are Michelle Stimpson, Tiffany L Warren, Stephanie Powell Watts, Pamela Samuels Young, Steven Barnes, Tananrive Due, Eric Jerome Dickey, and Kim Coles
Location: Fallbrook Church, 12512 Walters Road, Houston, TX
Weblinks: http://www.nationalblackbookfestival.com, https://twitter.com/blackbkfestival
Contacts: National Black Book Festival, info@nationalblackbookfestival.com

Thursday, Oct. 25 – Thursday, Nov. 01 Austin Film Festival – 25th Austin Film Festival and Writers Conference (AFF), championing writers’ contribution to film, television, and new media, opens with Brady Corbet’s musical drama ‘Vox Lux’, starring Natalie Portman, Jude Law and Christopher Abbott, followed by an in-conversation with Corbet. Further highlights include the marquee feature screenings of Yorgos Lanthimos’ historical drama ‘The Favourite’, starring Olivia Colman, Emma Stone and Rachel Weisz; Peter Farrelly’s comedy drama ‘Green Book’, starring Viggo Mortensen and Mahershala Ali; Steve McQueen’s crime thriller ‘Widows’, starring Viola Davis, Michelle Rodriguez and Elizabeth Debicki; the centerpiece film screening of Peter Hedges’ drama ‘Ben is Back’, starring Julia Roberts and Lucas Hedges; and the closing night film Jason Reitman’s biographical drama about Gary Hart, ‘The Front Runner’, starring Hugh Jackman. Includes presentation of the Extraordinary Contribution to Filmmaking Award to Roger Corman during Saturday’s annual Awards Luncheon
Location: Austin, TX
Contacts: Maya Perez , Austin Film Festival, maya@austinfilmfestival.com, 1 512 478 4795
